svg.aria-label: Keyboard C4 to G4. E4 lower voice and G4 upper voice in the minor third colour #8964A4. Three numbered hops: E4 to F4, F4 to F♯4, F♯4 to G4. 3 letters, 3 semitones: a minor third.
svg.title: The foundation moves: E4 and G4, a minor third

g.text: The same idea starting on E4
How to read this graphic: Count the three
arcs from E4 up to G4 (E to F, F to F♯, F♯ to
G). The keys and the bracket share the minor
third colour because that colour belongs to
the pair, wherever it sits on the keyboard.
The pair is E4 and G4, not C4 and E♭4.
